name: Elba Express Bridge Project (Canadys pipeline)

values.OtherEnglishNames: Elba Express Bridge Project; Canadys pipeline

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. The existing Elba Express Pipeline row is the operating 190 mile line from Elba Island. This is a new 71 mile 30 inch greenfield extension from a connection to that system in Screven County, Georgia, across the Savannah River to Colleton County, South Carolina, for a planned gas plant at Canadys (Santee Cooper and Dominion Energy South Carolina). A Kinder Morgan fact sheet gives 71 miles, 30 inch, about 431 million dollars, FERC pre-filing planned for the second quarter of 2026, a FERC application in the first quarter of 2027, construction in the first quarter of 2029 and service in the second quarter of 2030. The Kinder Morgan project page states 325 MMcf/d, long-term contracts with customers, and the same schedule. The EIA release of August 2026, sheet Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, Excel row 50, lists the project as Elba Express Bridge Project (EEBP), 431 million, 71 miles, 325, 30 inch, and notes landowner survey notices sent to about 185 South Carolina landowners in October 2025. The South Carolina Daily Gazette (October 2025) and the Post and Courier (2025) independently report 71 miles and about 431 million dollars. Expansion row shape: PipelineName matches P3295. Concrete step: customer contracts and landowner survey notices; the page says the project is supported by long-term contracts. Not confirmed: whether the FERC pre-filing request was actually filed (no docket found), so the step rests on contracts and surveys. EIA lists status Applied but the operator says no FERC filing until 2027, so status is proposed. Proposal year 2025 from the October 2025 landowner notices. No route found; the Coastal Conservation League map could not be fetched (bot block), so route is left for a route pass. Kinder Morgan fact sheet and project page are one origin; the news articles and EIA are separate origins. Tier medium.
